variants.suspected_cause: At the state-13 threshold, the target compares the computed threshold in a data register against record x in memory and branches on BGT; v11 loads x into a second register and branches on BLT.
variants.controlled_change: Swap only the relational operands to express computed_threshold <= record_x.

predicted_effect.note: The target uses a word branch while v11 uses a short branch; expected size increase is two bytes.
